rootCause: opencode calls non-existent MCP tool 'metabob_post_activity_result' instead of directly POSTing to backend API endpoint

components.desiredBehavior: Should successfully record execution data to backend database via HTTP POST to /api/v1/learning-loop/executions
components.gap: Uses MCP abstraction layer that doesn't have the required tool registered. Should use direct HTTP call to backend API.

components.assessment: ❌ BROKEN - This is the missing link
